market_outlook.short_term: Volatile. Iran-US escalation and strong payrolls create a tug-of-war: energy inflation vs. rate-hike fears. EM tech rally provides offset but is fragile. Expect 5-8% VIX spike. Bond markets remain under pressure. Oil likely tests new highs on tanker attack premium.
market_outlook.long_term: AI capex cycle remains structurally bullish but rotation from Nvidia to peers/storage/connectivity will define returns. Energy transition accelerated by geopolitical risk. EM maturation (Nigeria IPO, Malaysia bonds) offers 12-month alpha. Consumer squeeze persists through 2026 H2.
